reproduction: Place a FIFO at a disposable FetianFiles preferences path and load it in a child with a two-second deadline.
root_cause: Path stat permits non-regular files and read_text blocks on a FIFO; the earlier size check also does not bound a later read.
fix: Nonblocking no-follow open, fstat regular-file validation, bounded byte read.
after: passed: safe defaults without FIFO hang
remaining_limitations: Regular/network filesystem I/O has no hard deadline; no arbitrary disk fault claim.

reproduction: Load an invalid bracketed URI together with a valid bookmark, Dark theme and a null tabs field.
root_cause: A field validation exception discards the whole valid loaded configuration.
fix: Validate field types separately and skip malformed individual URIs.
before: failed: valid bookmark and theme lost in loaded state
remaining_limitations: Malformed on-disk content is not automatically repaired or migrated; no new backup schema.

reproduction: Run each complete session wrapper unprivileged with a fixture compositor that returns 42 if fd 9 is open.
root_cause: The wrapper's flock descriptor is inherited by the compositor and can be retained by descendants.
fix: Close fd 9 only in the compositor child; parent retains lock through cleanup.
after: both returned 0 and wrapper lock could be reacquired
remaining_limitations: Real Wayland descendant behavior and graphical relogin remain untested.

reproduction: Inject missing nm-applet or its immediate exit while the panel and other children remain healthy.
root_cause: Any child failure returned shell failure and terminated all healthy siblings.
fix: Log/isolate optional startup and exit failures, reap exited children, retain required panel failures.
before: optional failure tests failed; required-panel control already passed
remaining_limitations: Optional helpers require explicit shell restart after resolving their cause; no actual compositor crash test.

reproduction: Inject ENOSPC at fsync while replacing a temporary live-state fixture.
root_cause: Write/flush/fsync occurred outside the temporary cleanup finally block.
fix: Cover creation and write stages with cleanup while propagating the error and preserving prior state.
before: old state preserved but a .fetian-* file leaked
after: old state preserved and no leaked temporary
remaining_limitations: No physical power-cut or complete disk-full VM test; interrupted account creation still needs manual recovery.

classification: confirmed configuration gap; live restart storm not reproduced
reproduction: Inspect the four optional on-failure unit policies and compare their retry delays with an explicit rate window.
root_cause: No per-unit bounds; common manager defaults may not catch retries spaced beyond their short interval.
fix: Explicit three-start/120-second rate window, preserving on-failure restart delays and optional dependencies.
after: configuration checks and staged unit syntax passed
remaining_limitations: Start-rate bound is not a lifetime retry cap; actual user-manager rate limiting and lock/idle runtime remain untested.

classification: reproduced candidate-image extraction failure; repaired pipeline verified in CI
reproduction: Hosted ISO run 44505284369 built Hyprland successfully and verified installed pins, then isoinfo extraction produced unusable SquashFS input; unsquashfs rejected it. The embedded payload exceeded 2 GiB.
root_cause: The embedded-payload extraction path relies on isoinfo stdout and accepts its successful exit without checking for a regular nonempty output. The precise upstream size-handling defect remains unproven.
fix: Use native xorriso extraction with no user rc, no overwrite and failure-abort semantics; reject missing/empty/symlink outputs. Preserve unsquashfs, rootfs validation and embedded/staged package comparison.
before: Hosted Hyprland candidate image validation failed before boot; no invalid release was published. The attempted new local pre-fix contract check was blocked by automatic-review credit failure and was not executed.
after: Three contract checks passed locally; two real-tool cases were skipped locally. Hosted run 44540057276 completed all 130 tests with no skips, including the >2 GiB byte-exact roundtrip, and the repaired Hyprland image passed embedded-root validation and actual UEFI/live-account boot. Publication was skipped.
remaining_limitations: The precise upstream isoinfo size-handling defect remains unproven; graphical login and physical devices remain untested. No validator gate was removed.
